page.overview:
Who is Barnabas the Barmy?

Barnabas the Barmy was a wizard who made a bizarre and foolish attempt to train trolls for the ballet. A moving tapestry depicting his attempt hung on the seventh floor of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, opposite the entrance to the Room of Requirement.
